csharp-01-c2.text: Microsoft (2025). Boxing and Unboxing. Microsoft Learn (C# documentation).
csharp-01-c2.quote: Boxing a value type allocates an object instance on the heap and copies the value into the new object.
csharp-01-c2.claim: Boxing happens when you store a value type in an object reference, which allocates a heap box

csharp-01-c3.text: Microsoft (2025). Fundamentals of garbage collection. Microsoft Learn (.NET documentation).
csharp-01-c3.quote: The garbage collector stores new objects in generation 0.
csharp-01-c3.claim: New objects in the CLR start in Gen 0, where allocation is cheap

csharp-01-c3.text: Microsoft (2025). Fundamentals of garbage collection. Microsoft Learn (.NET documentation).
csharp-01-c3.quote: Objects that survive a generation 1 garbage collection are promoted to generation 2.
csharp-01-c3.claim: The CLR uses a generational, compacting garbage collector, so survivors are promoted to Gen 1, then Gen 2
